settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Inventory must expose stable category/subcategory/setting/manager destinations plus source, scope, exposure, requested/effective, availability, restart/reconnect, and changed-elsewhere state.

schema_event_storage_impacts: Persistent demo proves revisioned local projections; production needs typed operation/receipt identity, redaction, idempotency, and last-known-good recovery.
Provider installation identity must remain separate from accounts/connections/entitlements/models.
Settings import/copy/reset and backup/restore require preview, conflict policy, verification, and rollback state.
migration_supersession_impacts: Retire old category chip/bloom/no-sidebar contract and adjudicate cmd.settings.bloom.open as compatibility alias only.
Retire stale right-panel language in favor of responsive inspector/drawer/inline evidence.
Do not revive regular/yolo mode coupling or invalid inventory values.
slint_port_impacts: Map manager/resource collections to Slint ListModel structures.
Keep DOM geometry and IntersectionObserver out of product state; port section-position and focus signals.
Translate semantic motion blueprints (including transaction/preview) to Slint timelines with reduced-motion parity.
Use lazy manager hydration and bounded list virtualization for low-memory targets.
unresolved_questions: Exact command IDs and aliases require canonical UI Command Catalog adjudication.
Exact settings inventory IDs and schema fields require owner audit; concept fixture IDs are not canon.
changed_assumptions: ObservableWork is the sole truthful work/progress/wait owner; concept-local surfaces are projections/adapters.
RuntimeResourceGovernor alone owns resource policy/admission; Settings requests and projects policy, host enforcement uses the same contract, and no second governor exists.
Provider first acquisition, selecting an existing installation, authentication, verification, update, repair, and rollback are separate typed actions.

Provider CLI initial acquisition is never core/default baseline, preseeded, or silently triggered by Project/model/provider/Goal/Plan/WorkNode/agent/Auto/On; it requires official-source exact Host/Environment human consent.

Settings uses compact Home/search metadata, selected-manager-only hydration, generation currentness, byte bounds, virtualization, inactive unsubscribe/refcount release, transient-input non-persistence, and narrow frame-coalesced deltas.
Old-hardware/network/resource fixtures are deterministic projections, not native Slint or physical-hardware proof.
risk: Candidate command IDs may conflict with or duplicate canon until command catalog and owner census is complete.
A local progress card could drift into a second operation owner unless it remains a strict ObservableWork adapter.
A host capacity projection could drift into a second governor unless RuntimeResourceGovernor remains the single contract.
Stale continuation, incorrect Host/Environment, ambiguous installation ownership, or missing consent could acquire or bind the wrong provider CLI.
Full manager/search/catalog hydration or subscription leaks could violate old-hardware, memory, and network constraints.
Browser evidence could be overstated as native Slint certification.
Server owner placement is unresolved; fabricating it would create an engine outside this concept scope.
verification: jq parses every owned JSON artifact.
Assert every referenced command/component/owner ID is candidate-only, provisional, NOT_MINTED, or expressly subject to later census; no canonical availability is claimed.

Exercise provider result outcomes setup_required, candidate_selection_required, consent_required, accepted, queued, ready, failed, rolled_back, recovery_required, and stale_continuation with acquisition/auth/readiness kept separate.
Exercise RuntimeResourceGovernor outcomes admitted, queued, admitted_degraded, blocked_permission, blocked_resource, and cancelled through ObservableWork projections.

Verify compact Home/search metadata, selected-manager-only hydration, generation fencing, byte-bounded caches, at most 40 mounted rows, 825+ search fixtures, 100-installation fixtures, inactive unsubscribe/refcount behavior, transient-input non-persistence, and narrow frame-coalesced deltas.
Run deterministic poor CPU/RAM/disk/network and old-hardware projections, then retain native Slint and physical Ivy Bridge/Xeon validation as separate unresolved gates.
Search candidate artifacts for forbidden Playwright product/runtime/facade/compatibility/package/port/command/MCP/capture dependencies.
unresolved_defects: Exact canonical command IDs, aliases, payload schemas, owners, and wiring evidence are not yet adjudicated.
Exact canonical settings inventory/schema and Plan owner placements remain unresolved.
Server owner module is unresolved and remains insertion-only.
Native Slint rendering, accessibility, CPU/RAM/disk/network behavior, and actual Ivy Bridge/Xeon performance are not certified.
Required specialist review may need bounded waves under resource constraints but cannot be omitted.
deferred_owner_policy: Insertion-only; no Product Onboarding, Doctor, Installation/Deployment, Server Claim/Bootstrap, Project Sync/Move, app/content update, or Server engine is invented. Server ownership remains an explicit residual.

candidate_runtime_requirements.provider_typed_contract: Complete request/result fields and all seven distinct lifecycle actions are recorded in candidate-command-delta.json and candidate-wiring-delta.json.
